name: Night Shift at the Neon Foundry
description:
A build server at cyberpunk megacorp Neon Foundry may have been compromised during a late shift. Reconstruct what happened and recover the intruder's evidence. This host runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts use 172.20.0.141-199.

---

**Access** — SSH `root@172.20.0.141`, password `neonforge-44`

tasks.name: Reconstruct the Night Shift
tasks.description: Investigate the compromised Neon Foundry build server and recover the evidence left by its intruder. The host runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts use 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Build servers leave routine traces across accounts, scheduled work, logs, and file metadata. Compare those traces instead of trusting the loudest clue.
Package integrity records can help you check whether an installed system utility still matches its packaged version.
Follow up on any utility reported as changed: inspect its embedded text and consider whether its timestamps tell the whole story.
